examples.target: 請在溫習前把書桌上的灰塵抹去。

examples.source: You should wipe off the spilled milk with a clean cloth.
examples.target: 你應該用乾淨的布把灑出來的牛奶擦掉。

examples.source: I need to wipe off the marks on the whiteboard now.
examples.target: 我現在需要把白板上的痕跡擦掉。

wired to.meaning: 天生傾向於 / 與生俱來會

examples.source: Humans are wired to look for patterns in everything they see.
examples.target: 人類天生傾向於在所見的事物中尋找規律。

examples.source: My brother is wired to solve puzzles when he feels bored.
examples.target: 我弟弟感到無聊時，與生俱來就會想去解謎。

examples.source: Babies are wired to cry if they are hungry or tired.
examples.target: 嬰兒感到飢餓或疲倦時，天生就會哭鬧。

examples.source: She finished her homework with ease after studying hard.
examples.target: 她努力溫習後，能輕易地完成功課。

examples.source: He climbed the mountain with ease because he is very fit.
examples.target: 因為他身體很健康，所以能從容地爬上那座山。

examples.source: If you practise more, you can play this song with ease.
examples.target: 如果你多加練習，就能輕易地彈奏這首樂曲。

without doubt.meaning: 毫無疑問 / 無可置疑

examples.source: Without doubt, she is the best student in our class.
examples.target: 毫無疑問，她是我們班上最優秀的學生。

examples.source: This is without doubt the most exciting game of the year.
examples.target: 這毫無疑問是今年最刺激的一場比賽。

examples.source: He will without doubt succeed if he keeps working very hard.
examples.target: 如果他繼續努力，他毫無疑問會成功。

examples.source: She accepted the invitation without reservation because she likes parties.
examples.target: 她毫無保留地接受了邀請，因為她很喜歡派對。

examples.source: The teacher praised his hard work without reservation in class.
examples.target: 老師在課堂上毫無保留地稱讚他的努力。

examples.source: I support this plan without reservation if it helps everyone.
examples.target: 如果這個計劃能幫助大家，我會毫無保留地支持。

examples.source: The team was woefully unprepared for the difficult exam today.
examples.target: 這支隊伍對今天的艱深考試準備得非常不足。

examples.source: He is woefully lacking in experience for this new job.
examples.target: 他對於這份新工作而言，經驗極其缺乏。

examples.source: The old bridge is woefully unsafe when it rains heavily.
examples.target: 當下大雨時，這座舊橋顯得極其不安全。

examples.source: The Great Wall of China is a true wonder of the world.
examples.target: 萬里長城是世界真正的奇蹟。

examples.source: It is a wonder that the small plant grew in the desert.
examples.target: 這棵小植物能在沙漠中生長，真是一個奇蹟。

examples.source: We visited the natural wonder when we went to the park.
examples.target: 我們去公園時參觀了那個自然奇觀。

examples.source: I wonder why he is late for school today.
examples.target: 我好想知道他今天為什麼遲到。

examples.source: She wonders if it will rain tomorrow morning.
examples.target: 她想知道明天早上會不會下雨。

examples.source: We wondered where our teacher went after class.
examples.target: 我們想知道老師放學後去了哪裡。

examples.source: The bus to Ocean Park travels along Wong Chuk Hang Road.
examples.target: 前往海洋公園的巴士會途經黃竹坑道。

examples.source: There is a lot of traffic on Wong Chuk Hang Road today.
examples.target: 今天黃竹坑道的交通非常繁忙。

examples.source: You should turn left when you reach Wong Chuk Hang Road.
examples.target: 當你到達黃竹坑道時，應該轉左。

examples.source: Many people go to Wong Tai Sin to pray for good luck.
examples.target: 很多人會去黃大仙祈求好運。

examples.source: We can take the MTR to visit the Wong Tai Sin Temple.
examples.target: 我們可以乘搭港鐵去參觀黃大仙祠。

examples.source: Wong Tai Sin is a famous place in Hong Kong for tourists.
examples.target: 黃大仙是香港一個著名的旅遊景點。

examples.source: I love eating wonton noodles for lunch on Saturdays.
examples.target: 我喜歡在星期六午餐時吃雲吞麵。

examples.source: My father always buys wonton noodles when we feel hungry.
examples.target: 當我們感到肚餓時，爸爸總會買雲吞麵給我們吃。

examples.source: This small restaurant serves the best wonton noodles in town.
examples.target: 這間小店供應全城最好吃的雲吞麵。

examples.source: This sweater is made of soft wool to keep you warm.
examples.target: 這件毛衣由柔軟的羊毛製成，能讓你保持溫暖。

examples.source: You should wash this wool scarf carefully in cold water.
examples.target: 你應該用冷水小心地清洗這條羊毛圍巾。

examples.source: I feel itchy when I wear clothes made of wool.
examples.target: 當我穿著羊毛製成的衣服時，會感到皮膚痕癢。

work against.meaning: 對...不利 / 有負面影響

examples.source: The heavy rain will work against our plans for a picnic.
examples.target: 大雨會對我們的野餐計劃不利。

examples.source: His lack of experience worked against him during the job interview.
examples.target: 他在面試時缺乏經驗，這對他十分不利。

examples.source: The cold weather works against the growth of these tropical plants.
examples.target: 寒冷的天氣對這些熱帶植物的生長有負面影響。

examples.source: My new work pattern allows me to finish tasks earlier.
examples.target: 我新的工作模式讓我能更早完成任務。

examples.source: She changed her work pattern to spend more time with family.
examples.target: 她改變了工作模式，以便有更多時間陪伴家人。

examples.source: Does this work pattern suit you if you have many classes?
examples.target: 如果你有很多課，這種工作模式適合你嗎？

examples.source: The workload is too heavy for me to finish today.
examples.target: 對我來說，今天的工作量實在太大了。

examples.source: My teacher reduced our workload because we have many exams.
examples.target: 因為我們有很多考試，老師減少了我們的工作量。

examples.source: You will feel less stressed if you manage your workload well.
examples.target: 如果你能好好管理工作量，壓力就會減少。

examples.source: The internet connects people from all over the worldwide community.
examples.target: 互聯網連接了來自全世界的人們。

examples.source: This company has many offices in worldwide locations.
examples.target: 這家公司在全世界各地都有辦事處。

examples.source: We should care about environmental problems on a worldwide scale.
examples.target: 我們應該關注全世界範圍內的環境問題。

examples.source: The internet allows people to communicate worldwide easily.
examples.target: 互聯網讓人們可以輕鬆地與世界各地的人溝通。

examples.source: This famous singer is known worldwide for her beautiful songs.
examples.target: 這位著名歌手因她動聽的歌曲而聞名世界。

examples.source: Many companies sell their products worldwide to increase profits.
examples.target: 許多公司為了增加利潤，會把產品銷往世界各地。

examples.source: It is worrying that he has not arrived at school yet.
examples.target: 他還沒有到達學校，這真令人擔心。

examples.source: The teacher noticed a worrying drop in the students' test scores.
examples.target: 老師留意到學生的考試成績出現了令人擔心的跌幅。

examples.source: The rapid spread of the flu is very worrying for parents.
examples.target: 流感迅速蔓延，令家長感到非常擔心。

examples.source: I forgot my homework, and worse still, I lost my pen.
examples.target: 我忘記帶功課，更糟的是，我還弄丟了原子筆。

examples.source: It started to rain, and worse still, I had no umbrella.
examples.target: 開始下雨了，更糟的是，我沒有帶雨傘。

examples.source: The bus was late, and worse still, it was very crowded.
examples.target: 巴士遲到了，更糟的是，車上非常擠擁。

examples.source: The weather will worsen if it rains all day tomorrow.
examples.target: 如果明天整天下雨，天氣就會惡化。

examples.source: His cough started to worsen after he caught a cold.
examples.target: 他感冒後，咳嗽的情況開始惡化。

examples.source: Traffic will worsen when everyone leaves work at five o'clock.
examples.target: 當大家五點下班時，交通狀況會惡化。

examples.source: The old painting has great worth to my family.
examples.target: 這幅舊畫對我的家人來說很有價值。

examples.source: We should know the true worth of our time.
examples.target: 我們應該明白時間的真正價值。

examples.source: He does not understand the worth of hard work.
examples.target: 他不明白努力工作的價值。

examples.source: This book is worth reading because it has a great story.
examples.target: 這本書值得一讀，因為它的故事很精彩。

examples.source: It is worth waiting for the bus if you are tired.
examples.target: 如果你累了，等巴士是值得的。

examples.source: The movie was worth the money we spent on tickets.
examples.target: 這套電影值得我們花錢買票入場。

examples.source: This old toy is worthless because it is broken.
examples.target: 這件舊玩具已經壞了，所以沒有價值。

examples.source: He felt worthless when he failed the important exam.
examples.target: 當他考試不及格時，他感到自己沒有價值。

examples.source: It is worthless to keep clothes that do not fit.
examples.target: 留著不合身的衣服是沒有價值的。

examples.source: I would rather stay home than go out today.
examples.target: 我今天寧願留在家裡，也不想出去。

examples.source: She would rather eat noodles than have rice.
examples.target: 她寧願吃麵，也不想吃飯。

examples.source: I would rather walk if the weather is nice.
examples.target: 如果天氣好，我寧願走路。

examples.source: The team spent hours wrangling over the new project plan.
examples.target: 團隊花了數小時為新計劃爭論不休。

examples.source: After much wrangling, they finally agreed on the budget.
examples.target: 經過一番角力後，他們終於對預算達成共識。

examples.source: There was a lot of wrangling before the meeting started.
examples.target: 會議開始前，大家進行了激烈的角力。

examples.source: After hours of wrangling over the budget, the committee finally reached an agreement.
examples.target: 經過數小時關於預算的爭論後，委員會終於達成共識。

examples.source: The two parties are still wrangling about the terms of the new contract.
examples.target: 雙方仍在為新合約的條款爭拗不休。

examples.source: Constant wrangling between the team members is affecting our productivity.
examples.target: 團隊成員之間不斷的爭論正影響我們的工作效率。

examples.source: She wrapped the gift in blue paper.
examples.target: 她用藍色紙包好禮物。

examples.source: The worker wrapped the glass carefully.
examples.target: 工人小心地包裹玻璃。

examples.source: He wrapped the books before putting them away.
examples.target: 他把書包好才放起來。

examples.source: A silk wrap covered her shoulders.
examples.target: 一條絲質披肩蓋著她的肩膀。

examples.source: The box had a shiny wrap around it.
examples.target: 盒子外面有一層亮面的包裹物。

examples.source: The dancer wore a red wrap on stage.
examples.target: 舞者在台上披著一條紅色披肩。

examples.source: Please wrap the gift carefully with some colorful paper before the party.
examples.target: 派對開始前，請用彩紙把禮物小心地包好。

examples.source: I always wrap my sandwich in foil to keep it fresh for lunch.
examples.target: 我總是會用錫紙把三文治包起來，讓午餐保持新鮮。

examples.source: The doctor had to wrap her injured ankle with a soft bandage today.
examples.target: 醫生今天必須用柔軟的繃帶把她受傷的腳踝包紮起來。

examples.source: I bought a chicken wrap for lunch.
examples.target: 我午餐買了一個雞肉卷餅。

examples.source: The vegetable wrap was warm and soft.
examples.target: 蔬菜卷餅又暖又軟。

examples.source: The menu has a tuna wrap.
examples.target: 餐牌上有吞拿魚卷餅。

examples.source: The workers cleared the wreckage from the road after the accident.
examples.target: 意外發生後，工人們清理了路面上的殘骸。

examples.source: We saw the wreckage of the old ship on the beach.
examples.target: 我們在沙灘上看到了那艘舊船的殘骸。

examples.source: The team searched through the wreckage to find important items.
examples.target: 團隊在殘骸中搜尋，希望找到重要的物品。

examples.source: I had to wrestle with a difficult math problem today.
examples.target: 我今天不得不努力應付一道困難的數學題。

examples.source: She is wrestling with the decision of which school to join.
examples.target: 她正在為選擇哪一間學校而感到苦惱。

examples.source: Many students wrestle with their homework when they are tired.
examples.target: 當學生感到疲倦時，往往會難以應付功課。

examples.source: The government is wrestling with the problem of rising housing costs.
examples.target: 政府正努力應付樓價高企的問題。

examples.source: She had to wrestle with her conscience before making the final decision.
examples.target: 她在作出最終決定前，曾與自己的良心掙扎一番。

examples.source: Many students are still wrestling with the complex concepts in the new syllabus.
examples.target: 許多學生仍在努力鑽研新課程中複雜的概念。

write off.meaning: 勾銷 / 報廢 / 不再理會

examples.source: The company decided to write off the old broken computers.
examples.target: 公司決定將那些損壞的舊電腦報廢。

examples.source: Do not write off your chances of winning the game.
examples.target: 不要輕易放棄你贏得比賽的機會。

examples.source: The bank had to write off the debt because he moved away.
examples.target: 因為他搬走了，銀行只好將這筆債務勾銷。

examples.source: He uses his weekly wage to pay for his school bus fees.
examples.target: 他用每週的工資來支付校車費用。

examples.source: The part-time job offers a fair hourly wage for local students.
examples.target: 這份兼職工作為本地學生提供合理的時薪。

examples.source: Many workers are asking for a higher wage to cover living costs.
examples.target: 許多工人正要求提高工資以應付生活開支。

examples.source: Global warming is causing more extreme weather patterns around the world today.
examples.target: 全球暖化正導致世界各地出現更多極端天氣。

examples.source: We must take action to slow down the warming of our planet.
examples.target: 我們必須採取行動，以減緩地球變暖的速度。

examples.source: Scientists are worried about the rapid warming of the Earth's polar regions.
examples.target: 科學家們正擔心地球極地地區的急劇變暖。

examples.source: He felt a sudden weakness in his legs after running for an hour.
examples.target: 跑了一個小時後，他感到雙腿一陣虛弱。

examples.source: The patient is still suffering from weakness after his long illness.
examples.target: 那位病人大病初癒後，身體仍然感到虛弱。

examples.source: A lack of sleep can cause weakness and make you feel very tired.
examples.target: 睡眠不足會導致身體虛弱，讓你感到非常疲倦。

examples.source: Everyone has a weakness, so you should not worry about your mistakes.
examples.target: 每個人都有弱點，所以你不必為自己的錯誤感到擔心。

examples.source: His greatest weakness is that he finds it hard to speak in public.
examples.target: 他最大的弱點就是覺得在公眾面前發言很困難。

examples.source: You need to identify your weakness and work hard to improve it today.
examples.target: 你需要找出自己的弱點，並努力在今天將其改善。

examples.source: The wealthy businessman donated a lot of money to our school library.
examples.target: 那位富有的商人捐了很多錢給我們的學校圖書館。

examples.source: She comes from a wealthy family and lives in a large house.
examples.target: 她來自一個富有的家庭，住在一間大房子裡。

examples.source: It is not easy to become wealthy without working very hard every day.
examples.target: 如果不每天努力工作，想要變得富有並不容易。

examples.source: Our school holds a short assembly in the hall weekly on Monday mornings.
examples.target: 我們學校每週一早上都會在禮堂舉行簡短的週會。

examples.source: I have to clean my bedroom weekly to keep everything tidy and organized.
examples.target: 我每週都要打掃一次睡房，好讓所有東西都保持整潔有序。

examples.source: The local library updates its collection of new books weekly for the public.
examples.target: 本地圖書館每週都會為公眾更新一次新書館藏。

examples.source: I bought a weekly to read during my long bus ride to school.
examples.target: 我買了一本週刊，打算在乘搭長途巴士上學時閱讀。

examples.source: My father enjoys reading his favourite weekly every Sunday morning at home.
examples.target: 我爸爸喜歡在每個星期日早上，留在家中閱讀他最喜愛的週刊。

examples.source: The school library has a new weekly that covers the latest science news.
examples.target: 學校圖書館有一本新的週刊，內容涵蓋了最新的科學新聞。

examples.source: Our class has a weekly meeting to discuss our upcoming school projects.
examples.target: 我們班每週都有會議，討論即將進行的學校專題。

examples.source: I have a weekly piano lesson every Saturday morning at ten o'clock.
examples.target: 我每週六早上十點都要上鋼琴課。

examples.source: The teacher gives us a weekly quiz to check our learning progress.
examples.target: 老師每週都會給我們測驗，以檢查我們的學習進度。

examples.source: The government provides social welfare to support families in need of financial help.
examples.target: 政府提供社會福利，以支援有經濟困難的家庭。

examples.source: Our school cares about the welfare of every student during the exam period.
examples.target: 我們學校非常關心每位學生在考試期間的身心福祉。

examples.source: Many people rely on government welfare to pay for their basic daily expenses.
examples.target: 許多人依靠政府福利來支付他們的基本日常開支。

examples.source: The government provides social welfare to help families in need of support.
examples.target: 政府提供社會福利，以幫助有需要的家庭。

examples.source: Our school cares about the mental welfare of all the students here.
examples.target: 我們學校非常關心這裡所有學生的身心健康。

examples.source: Many people rely on government welfare to pay for their daily expenses.
examples.target: 許多人依靠政府福利來支付他們的日常開支。

examples.source: The school cares about the physical and mental well-being of all students.
examples.target: 學校非常關心所有學生的身心健康。

examples.source: Eating healthy food and exercising regularly are important for your general well-being.
examples.target: 均衡飲食和定期運動對你的整體身心健康很重要。

examples.source: We should always put our personal well-being before working too many long hours.
examples.target: 我們應該時刻把身心健康放在首位，而不應過度超時工作。

examples.source: The school places a high priority on the physical and mental well-being of its students.
examples.target: 學校非常重視學生的身心健康。

examples.source: Regular exercise is essential for your overall well-being.
examples.target: 恆常運動對你的整體身心健康至關重要。

examples.source: The government is committed to improving the social well-being of the elderly.
examples.target: 政府致力於改善長者的社會福祉。

examples.source: She wept silently when she heard the sad news about her pet.
examples.target: 當她聽到關於寵物的壞消息時，不禁默默流淚。

examples.source: The young boy wept because he could not find his lost toy.
examples.target: 那個小男孩因為找不到遺失的玩具而哭了起來。

examples.target: 在贏得錦標賽的最後一場比賽後，他們喜極而泣。

examples.target: 農夫通常會在炎熱的夏季收割田裡的小麥。

examples.source: Many types of bread and pasta are made from ground wheat flour daily.
examples.target: 許多種類的麵包和意粉都是用小麥粉磨製而成的。

examples.source: The golden wheat sways gently in the wind across the large open farm.
examples.target: 金黃色的小麥在大農場裡隨風輕輕搖曳。

examples.source: When it comes to playing basketball, he is the best in our class.
examples.target: 當談到打籃球時，他是我們班上最厲害的。

examples.source: My brother is very shy when it comes to meeting new people.
examples.target: 當談到結識新朋友時，我弟弟會感到很害羞。

examples.source: When it comes to choosing a hobby, I prefer reading over playing games.
examples.target: 當談到選擇興趣時，我比起玩遊戲更喜歡閱讀。

examples.source: I love playing basketball, whereas my brother prefers to play video games.
examples.target: 我喜歡打籃球，而我弟弟則比較喜歡玩電子遊戲。

examples.source: My sister is very outgoing, whereas I am quite shy at school.
examples.target: 我姐姐性格非常外向，然而我在學校卻相當害羞。

examples.target: 他很快就完成了功課，而我卻還在為自己的功課煩惱。

examples.source: You can sit wherever you like in this quiet school library today.
examples.target: 你今天可以在這間安靜的學校圖書館裡隨便坐。

examples.source: My dog follows me wherever I go when we are at home.
examples.target: 當我們在家時，我的狗無論我走到哪裡都會跟著我。

examples.source: Please feel free to take photos wherever you see a beautiful view.
examples.target: 無論你在哪裡看到美麗的景色，請隨意拍照。

examples.source: You can sit wherever you like in this quiet school library today.
examples.target: 你今天可以在這間安靜的學校圖書館裡，隨便坐在任何位置。

examples.source: My dog follows me wherever I go when we are at home.
examples.target: 當我們在家時，我的狗無論我走到哪裡都會跟著我。

examples.source: We should keep our city clean wherever we go in Hong Kong.
examples.target: 無論我們在香港走到哪裡，都應該保持城市清潔。

examples.source: The factory reduced waste, which in turn lowered our production costs significantly.
examples.target: 工廠減少了浪費，從而大幅降低了我們的生產成本。

examples.source: Regular exercise improves sleep, which in turn helps you focus during lessons.
examples.target: 恆常運動能改善睡眠，繼而幫助你在課堂上集中精神。

examples.source: The heavy rain caused flooding, which in turn delayed the school bus.
examples.target: 大雨引發了水浸，從而導致校巴延誤。

examples.source: Please whisper so you do not disturb the other students in the library.
examples.target: 請低聲說話，以免打擾圖書館裡的其他同學。

examples.source: She leaned over to whisper a secret in her best friend's ear.
examples.target: 她俯身在好朋友耳邊低聲說了一個秘密。

examples.source: The teacher had to whisper because the students were taking a test.
examples.target: 老師不得不低聲說話，因為學生們正在進行考試。

examples.source: She spoke in a soft whisper so that the teacher would not hear.
examples.target: 她輕聲細語地說話，以免被老師聽見。

examples.source: I heard a quiet whisper coming from the back of the classroom today.
examples.target: 我今天聽到課室後面傳來一陣輕聲細語。

examples.source: They shared a secret in a whisper while waiting for the bus home.
examples.target: 他們在等巴士回家時，輕聲細語地分享了一個秘密。

examples.source: She whispered so the teacher would not hear her.
examples.target: 她低聲說話，以免被老師聽到。

examples.source: I heard someone whisper at the back of the classroom.
examples.target: 我聽到有人在課室後面低聲說話。

examples.source: They whispered a secret during the lunch break today.
examples.target: 他們今天午飯時間低聲說了一個秘密。

examples.source: Whoever finishes the homework first can go to the playground to play.
examples.target: 無論誰先完成功課，都可以去操場玩耍。

examples.source: You should be kind to whoever you meet at the new school today.
examples.target: 無論你在新學校遇到誰，你都應該對他們友善。

examples.source: Whoever wants to join the basketball team should sign up by Friday afternoon.
examples.target: 任何人想參加籃球隊的話，請在星期五下午前報名。

examples.source: This is the teacher to whom I spoke about my homework today.
examples.target: 這就是我今天談論功課的那位老師。

examples.source: The boy with whom I play basketball is my best friend.
examples.target: 跟我一起打籃球的那個男生是我最好的朋友。

examples.source: To whom should I send this application form for the club?
examples.target: 我應該把這份學會申請表交給誰？

examples.source: This new teaching method is now widely used in many local secondary schools.
examples.target: 這種新的教學方法現時已在許多本地中學被廣泛使用。

examples.source: The news about the school concert was widely shared on social media today.
examples.target: 關於學校音樂會的消息今天在社交媒體上被廣泛轉發。

examples.source: The company is widely known for producing high quality and affordable electronic products.
examples.target: 這間公司以生產優質且價格實惠的電子產品而廣為人知。

widen our horizons.meaning: 擴闊視野 / 增廣見聞

examples.source: Reading different types of books helps us widen our horizons significantly.
examples.target: 閱讀不同類型的書籍有助我們大大擴闊視野。

examples.source: Joining the school exchange program is a great way to widen our horizons.
examples.target: 參加學校的交流計劃是擴闊視野的好方法。

examples.source: Traveling to foreign countries allows students to widen our horizons and learn more.
examples.target: 到外國旅遊能讓學生增廣見聞，並學到更多知識。

examples.source: The use of smartphones is now widespread among students in our school.
examples.target: 現在我們學校的學生普遍都會使用智能手機。

examples.source: There is widespread concern about the impact of climate change on nature.
examples.target: 大眾對於氣候變化對大自然的影響感到非常擔憂。

examples.source: This new teaching method has gained widespread support from many local teachers.
examples.target: 這種新的教學方法得到了許多本地老師的廣泛支持。

examples.source: We should protect the local wildlife when we go hiking in the countryside.
examples.target: 我們去郊外遠足時，應該保護當地的野生動物。

examples.source: The documentary shows how wildlife survives in the harsh desert environment every day.
examples.target: 這部紀錄片展示了野生動物如何在嚴酷的沙漠環境中生存。

examples.source: Many people enjoy taking photos of the wildlife in Hong Kong Wetland Park.
examples.target: 許多人都喜歡在香港濕地公園拍攝野生動物的照片。

examples.source: The final exam will start soon, so I must finish my revision today.
examples.target: 期末考試快將開始，所以我今天必須完成複習。

examples.source: My brother will graduate from university soon and start looking for a job.
examples.target: 我哥哥快將大學畢業，並開始尋找工作。

examples.source: The weather report says that the heavy rain will stop soon this afternoon.
examples.target: 天氣報告說大雨快將在今天下午停止。

examples.source: The technician needs to wire the new lamp to the ceiling light switch.
examples.target: 技術人員需要將新燈具接駁到天花板的電燈開關上。

examples.source: My grandfather used to wire money to his family living in another country.
examples.target: 我祖父以前經常匯款給住在另一個國家的家人。

examples.source: You must wire the alarm system carefully to ensure it works properly today.
examples.target: 你必須小心地接駁警報系統，以確保它今天能正常運作。

examples.source: Please make sure the wire is connected properly to the power outlet.
examples.target: 請確保電線已經正確地連接到電源插座上。

examples.source: The technician repaired the broken wire so the computer could work again.
examples.target: 技術員修理好了那條斷掉的電線，電腦就能夠再次運作了。

examples.source: Be careful not to trip over the loose wire on the floor.
examples.target: 小心不要被地板上那條鬆脫的電線絆倒。

examples.source: My grandmother has the wisdom to solve almost any problem we face.
examples.target: 我祖母擁有智慧，能解決我們面對的幾乎所有問題。

examples.source: It takes great wisdom to know when to speak and when to listen.
examples.target: 知道何時該說話、何時該聆聽，需要很大的智慧。

examples.source: Reading many books is a good way to gain knowledge and wisdom.
examples.target: 閱讀很多書籍是獲取知識和智慧的好方法。

examples.source: It is wise to save some pocket money for future needs.
examples.target: 把部分零用錢儲蓄起來以備不時之需，是明智的做法。

examples.source: She made a wise decision to study harder before the final exam.
examples.target: 她在期末考試前決定加倍努力溫習，是一個明智的決定。

examples.source: Listening to your teacher's advice is a wise way to learn.
examples.target: 聽取老師的建議，是學習過程中明智的方法。

examples.source: With regard to your question, I will provide an answer tomorrow morning.
examples.target: 關於你的問題，我會在明天早上給你答覆。

examples.source: The teacher spoke to the class with regard to the upcoming school trip.
examples.target: 老師向全班同學談及即將舉行的學校旅行。

examples.source: We need more information with regard to the new rules in the library.
examples.target: 關於圖書館的新規則，我們需要更多相關資訊。

examples.source: With regard to the school trip, please submit your permission slips by Friday.
examples.target: 關於學校旅行的事宜，請在星期五前交回你的家長同意書。

examples.source: The teacher spoke to us with regard to our poor performance in class.
examples.target: 老師就我們在課堂上表現欠佳一事與我們談話。

examples.source: I have no further comments with regard to the new homework policy today.
examples.target: 關於新的功課政策，我今天沒有其他意見了。

examples.source: The movie was quite long; with that said, I still enjoyed every minute.
examples.target: 這部電影確實很長；即使如此，我仍然享受每一分鐘。

examples.source: It is a difficult task; with that said, we should try our best.
examples.target: 這是一項艱巨的任務；即使如此，我們仍然應該盡力而為。

examples.source: The weather is cold today; with that said, we must go for a run.
examples.target: 今天天氣很冷；即使如此，我們仍然必須去跑步。

with the absence of.meaning: 在沒有某事物的情況下

examples.source: With the absence of rain, the school sports day went very smoothly today.
examples.target: 在沒有下雨的情況下，今天的學校運動會進行得非常順利。

examples.source: With the absence of our teacher, we studied quietly in the library instead.
examples.target: 在沒有老師的情況下，我們改在圖書館安靜地自修。

examples.source: With the absence of clear instructions, the students felt confused about the project.
examples.target: 在沒有清晰指引的情況下，學生們對這份專題報告感到困惑。

withdraw.meaning: 退出 / 下架 / 提款

examples.source: I need to go to the bank to withdraw some cash for lunch.
examples.target: 我需要去銀行提款，用來買午餐。

examples.source: The store decided to withdraw the faulty product from all its shelves.
examples.target: 商店決定將有問題的產品全數下架。

examples.source: She had to withdraw from the competition because she was feeling very sick.
examples.target: 她因為身體很不舒服，不得不退出比賽。

examples.source: The student decided to withdraw from the singing competition due to a sore throat.
examples.target: 因為喉嚨痛，那位學生決定退出歌唱比賽。

examples.source: She chose to withdraw from the race because she felt very tired today.
examples.target: 因為今天感到很累，她選擇退出這場比賽。

examples.source: If you are not feeling well, you can withdraw from the school sports day.
examples.target: 如果你身體不舒服，你可以選擇不參加學校運動會。

examples.source: I need to go to the bank to withdraw some cash today.
examples.target: 我今天需要去銀行提款。

examples.source: She used the ATM to withdraw money for her school trip.
examples.target: 她用櫃員機提款，作為學校旅行的費用。

examples.source: Please remember to withdraw enough money before we go shopping later.
examples.target: 我們稍後去購物前，請記得先提款。

examples.source: I need to go to the bank to withdraw some cash today.
examples.target: 我今天需要去銀行提取一些現金。

examples.source: The student decided to withdraw his application from the school club.
examples.target: 那位學生決定撤回他對學校學會的申請。

examples.source: He had to withdraw from the competition because he was sick.
examples.target: 因為生病了，他不得不退出這次比賽。

withdrawn.meaning: 已撤回 / 已退出 / 已提取

examples.source: He has withdrawn all his savings from the bank to buy a laptop.
examples.target: 他已經從銀行提走了所有存款，用來購買一部手提電腦。

examples.source: The team has withdrawn from the basketball competition due to many injuries.
examples.target: 由於多名球員受傷，該隊伍已經退出了這次籃球比賽。

examples.source: The company has withdrawn the faulty product from the market immediately.
examples.target: 公司已經立即將該項有瑕疵的產品從市場上撤回。

withdrew.meaning: 撤回了 / 退出了 / 提取了

examples.source: He withdrew some money from the bank to buy a new laptop.
examples.target: 他從銀行提了一些錢出來，準備買一部新手提電腦。

examples.source: The tennis player withdrew from the competition because of a bad injury.
examples.target: 那位網球選手因為受了重傷，退出了這次比賽。

examples.source: She withdrew her hand quickly when she touched the hot metal pot.
examples.target: 她碰到那個熱金屬鍋時，立刻縮回了手。

without further delay.meaning: 事不宜遲 / 不再拖延

examples.source: We should start our group project without further delay to finish on time.
examples.target: 為了準時完成，我們應該事不宜遲地開始小組專題研習。

examples.source: The teacher said we must submit our homework without further delay this afternoon.
examples.target: 老師說我們今午必須事不宜遲地遞交功課。

examples.source: Please sign these important school documents without further delay and return them tomorrow.
examples.target: 請事不宜遲地簽署這些重要的學校文件，並於明天交回。

examples.source: She passed the difficult math test without much effort this morning.
examples.target: 她今天早上輕而易舉地通過了那次困難的數學測驗。

examples.source: With his long legs, he climbed the hill without much effort.
examples.target: 憑藉著雙長腿，他輕而易舉地爬上了那座小山。

examples.source: The talented swimmer won the race without much effort yesterday.
examples.target: 那位天才泳手昨天輕而易舉地贏得了比賽。

examples.source: I happened to witness a small accident on my way to school today.
examples.target: 我今天上學途中剛好目擊了一宗小意外。

examples.source: Many students gathered to witness the final match of the basketball tournament.
examples.target: 許多學生聚集在一起，見證了籃球比賽的決賽。

examples.source: She was lucky enough to witness the rare bird in the city park.
examples.target: 她很幸運，在城市公園裡親眼目擊了那種罕見的鳥類。

examples.source: The police asked the witness to describe what happened at the park.
examples.target: 警察要求該名目擊者描述公園裡發生的事情。

examples.source: She was the only witness to the accident on the school playground.
examples.target: 她是這宗學校操場意外唯一的目擊者。

examples.source: We were lucky to witness the beautiful sunset from the mountain top.
examples.target: 我們很幸運能在山頂親眼見證美麗的日落。

examples.source: The police asked the witness to describe what happened at the bus stop.
examples.target: 警方要求目擊者描述巴士站發生的事情。

examples.source: She was the only witness to the accident that happened on the street.
examples.target: 她是那宗街頭意外中唯一的目擊者。

examples.source: A witness told the teacher that the two students were arguing during recess.
examples.target: 一名目擊者告訴老師，那兩名學生在小息時發生爭執。

examples.source: Practising hard for the interview will definitely work in your favour.
examples.target: 為面試努力練習絕對會對你有利。

examples.source: Having a good relationship with your teacher can work in your favour.
examples.target: 與老師保持良好關係可能會對你有利。

examples.source: The sunny weather today will work in your favour for the picnic.
examples.target: 今天陽光普照的天氣對你的野餐計劃十分有利。

examples.source: I tried restarting the computer and it worked like a charm.
examples.target: 我試過重啟電腦，結果非常有效。

examples.source: This simple trick to fix the squeaky door worked like a charm.
examples.target: 這個修理門鉸異響的小撇步非常有奇效。

examples.source: Using a study planner really worked like a charm for my exams.
examples.target: 使用溫習計劃表對我的考試非常有奇效。

examples.source: This new study app really works like a charm on my exam revision.
examples.target: 這個新的學習應用程式對我的考試溫習真的非常有效。

examples.source: The gentle music worked like a charm on my little brother's bad mood.
examples.target: 柔和的音樂對我弟弟的壞心情非常有效。

examples.source: A bit of extra practice works like a charm on improving your English.
examples.target: 多做一點額外練習對提升你的英語水平非常有效。

workforce.meaning: 勞動人口 / 員工隊伍

examples.source: The company is trying to recruit more young people into its workforce.
examples.target: 這間公司正嘗試招聘更多年輕人加入其員工隊伍。

examples.source: Women now make up a large part of the global professional workforce.
examples.target: 女性現時佔全球專業勞動人口的一大部分。

examples.source: The government wants to improve the skills of the local workforce.
examples.target: 政府希望提升本地勞動人口的技能。

examples.source: The company has a young workforce.
examples.target: 公司有一支年輕員工隊伍。

examples.source: Training can improve the skills of the workforce.
examples.target: 培訓可以提升勞動力技能。

examples.source: The report studies changes in the local workforce.
examples.target: 報告研究本地勞動力變化。

examples.source: It is important to maintain a professional attitude in the workplace.
examples.target: 在工作場所保持專業的態度是非常重要的。

examples.source: My workplace is quite far from home, so I take the bus.
examples.target: 我的工作場所離家很遠，所以我通常會搭巴士去。

examples.source: We should keep our workplace clean and tidy for better efficiency.
examples.target: 我們應該保持工作場所整潔，以提高工作效率。

examples.source: Our school is organizing a photography workshop for students next Saturday.
examples.target: 我們學校將於下星期六為學生舉辦一個攝影工作坊。

examples.source: I learned how to make handmade soap in the afternoon workshop.
examples.target: 我在下午的工作坊裡學會了如何製作手工皂。

examples.source: You should sign up for the writing workshop to improve your skills.
examples.target: 你應該報名參加寫作工作坊，以提升你的寫作技巧。

examples.source: The students visited a furniture workshop to learn how to make wooden chairs.
examples.target: 學生們參觀了一間傢俬工場，學習如何製作木椅。

examples.source: My father spends most of his time working in his small metal workshop.
examples.target: 我爸爸大部分時間都在他的小型金屬工場工作。

examples.source: The school set up a new workshop for students to repair their bicycles.
examples.target: 學校設立了一個新的維修車間，讓學生可以修理他們的單車。

examples.source: The early bird catches the worm, so wake up early for school.
examples.target: 早起的鳥兒有蟲吃，所以你要早點起床上學。

examples.source: I found a small worm crawling on the leaf in our garden.
examples.target: 我在花園的葉子上發現了一條正在爬行的小蟲。

examples.source: Please wash the vegetables carefully to remove any hidden worms or dirt.
examples.target: 請小心清洗蔬菜，以洗掉隱藏的蟲子或泥土。

examples.source: I found a small worm crawling on the apple in my lunch box.
examples.target: 我在飯盒的蘋果上發現了一條小蟲子在爬。

examples.source: The gardener said that some worms are actually good for the soil.
examples.target: 園丁說有些蟲子其實對泥土很有益處。

examples.source: We saw a worm on the grass after the heavy rain yesterday morning.
examples.target: 昨天早上大雨過後，我們在草地上看到了一條蟲子。

examples.source: The early bird catches the worm, so please start your revision today.
examples.target: 早起的鳥兒有蟲吃，所以請你今天就開始溫習。

examples.source: I saw a small worm crawling slowly across the grass in the park.
examples.target: 我看見一條小蟲在公園的草地上緩慢地爬行。

examples.source: After the heavy rain, many worms came out of the wet soil.
examples.target: 大雨過後，許多蠕蟲從潮濕的泥土裡鑽了出來。

examples.source: I would like to join the school basketball team this coming semester.
examples.target: 我下學期想參加學校的籃球隊。

examples.source: My teacher would like to talk about our progress in the project.
examples.target: 我的老師想跟我們談談這個專題研習的進度。

examples.source: We would like to order two bowls of noodles for our lunch.
examples.target: 我們午餐想點兩碗麵。

examples.source: The sharp edge of the broken glass could easily wound your bare feet.
examples.target: 碎玻璃的鋒利邊緣很容易會割傷你的赤腳。

examples.source: He did not mean to wound her feelings with those harsh words.
examples.target: 他並不是有意用那些刻薄的話傷害她的感情。

examples.source: Be careful when you use the knife so you do not wound yourself.
examples.target: 使用刀具時要小心，以免弄傷自己。

examples.source: He cleaned the small wound on his knee after falling down yesterday.
examples.target: 他昨天跌倒後，清理了膝蓋上的小傷口。

examples.source: Please cover the wound with a clean bandage to keep it safe.
examples.target: 請用乾淨的繃帶包紮傷口，以確保衛生。

examples.source: The doctor checked my arm to see if the wound was healing.
examples.target: 醫生檢查了我的手臂，看看傷口是否正在癒合。

examples.source: She wove a beautiful basket using dried grass from the school garden.
examples.target: 她用學校花園裡的乾草編織了一個漂亮的籃子。

examples.source: The artist wove colourful ribbons together to create a unique piece of art.
examples.target: 藝術家將彩帶編織在一起，創作出獨一無二的藝術品。

examples.source: He wove a fascinating story about his summer trip to the countryside.
examples.target: 他編織了一個關於他暑假去鄉村旅行的精彩故事。

examples.source: The basket was woven from thin strips of dried bamboo by the artist.
examples.target: 這個籃子是由藝術家用乾竹條編織而成的。

wielding.meaning: 持有並使用的 / 揮舞的

wily.meaning: 狡猾的 / 老謀深算的

examples.target: 狡猾的狐狸避開陷阱。

examples.target: 老謀深算的談判者知道何時保持沉默。

wistful.meaning: 惆悵懷念的 / 渴望的

woozy.meaning: 頭暈的 / 昏昏沉沉的

wordsmith.meaning: 文字高手 / 擅長文字創作的人

examples.target: 那位編輯是文字高手。

examples.target: 好的文字創作者能令簡單想法變得有力。

workaround.meaning: 變通辦法 / 臨時解決方法

worldly.meaning: 見多識廣的 / 世故的

examples.source: The cake weighed in at almost two kilograms.
examples.target: 蛋糕重達差不多兩公斤。

examples.source: The exam weighed on his mind all week.
examples.target: 考試整星期都令他掛心。

examples.source: Family problems can weigh on students.
examples.target: 家庭問題會令學生有壓力。

examples.source: The mistake weighed on her for days.
examples.target: 那個錯誤令她掛心了幾日。

examples.source: Weigh out two hundred grams of flour.
examples.target: 稱出二百克麵粉。

examples.source: The shopkeeper weighed out some rice.
examples.target: 店主稱出一些米。

examples.source: She weighed out the ingredients carefully.
examples.target: 她小心量出材料重量。

examples.source: We need to weigh up the risks.
examples.target: 我們需要權衡風險。

examples.source: She weighed up both choices before deciding.
examples.target: 決定前她仔細考慮兩個選擇。

examples.source: The committee weighed up the cost and benefits.
examples.target: 委員會權衡成本和好處。

examples.source: This is a well thought-out plan.
examples.target: 這是一個經過周詳考慮的計劃。

examples.source: Her answer was clear and well thought-out.
examples.target: 她的答案清晰而且經過周詳考慮。

examples.source: A well thought-out timetable saves time.
examples.target: 經過周詳考慮的時間表可以節省時間。

examples.source: Family is what matters to her most.
examples.target: 家庭是對她最重要的事。

examples.source: Ask students what matters to them.
examples.target: 問問學生甚麼事對他們重要。

examples.source: Health is what matters to many parents.
examples.target: 健康是很多家長重視的事。

examples.source: What on earth are you doing?
examples.target: 你到底在做甚麼？

examples.source: What on earth happened to the classroom?
examples.target: 課室究竟發生了甚麼事？

examples.source: I could not understand what on earth he meant.
examples.target: 我不明白他到底是甚麼意思。

examples.source: Art is where her talent lies.
examples.target: 藝術是她的才能所在。

examples.source: He discovered where his talent lay after joining the club.
examples.target: 加入學會後，他發現自己的才能所在。

examples.source: Teachers help students find where their talent lies.
examples.target: 老師幫助學生找出自己的才能所在。

win someone over.meaning: 打動某人 / 令某人信服

examples.source: Her honesty won the audience over.
examples.target: 她的誠實打動了觀眾。

examples.source: The new teacher slowly won the class over.
examples.target: 新老師慢慢令全班信服。

examples.source: A good example can win people over.
examples.target: 一個好例子可以令人信服。

examples.source: The singer won the crowd over with one song.
examples.target: 歌手用一首歌贏得觀眾歡心。

examples.source: Her speech won the crowd over.
examples.target: 她的演說贏得觀眾歡心。

examples.source: The team won the crowd over with hard work.
examples.target: 團隊以努力贏得觀眾歡心。

wind up.meaning: 結果落得 / 最後變成

examples.source: We wound up staying at home.
examples.target: 結果我們留在家中。

examples.source: He wound up becoming a teacher.
examples.target: 他最後變成一名老師。

examples.source: Without a plan, you may wind up wasting time.
examples.target: 沒有計劃，你最後可能浪費時間。

with a straight face.meaning: 一本正經地 / 忍住不笑地

examples.source: He told the joke with a straight face.
examples.target: 他一本正經地說笑話。

examples.source: She could not read the silly line with a straight face.
examples.target: 她無法忍住不笑地讀那句搞笑對白。

examples.source: The actor stayed with a straight face on stage.
examples.target: 演員在台上保持一本正經。

examples.source: The course is designed with an emphasis on speaking.
examples.target: 課程設計著重於口語。

examples.source: The report was written with an emphasis on safety.
examples.target: 報告撰寫時重點放在安全。

examples.source: Lessons with an emphasis on practice help students remember.
examples.target: 著重於練習的課堂幫助學生記憶。

examples.source: He looked at the unfair rule with contempt.
examples.target: 他輕蔑地看待那條不公平規則。

examples.source: The character spoke with contempt in the scene.
examples.target: 角色在那一幕中鄙視地說話。

examples.source: We should not treat others with contempt.
examples.target: 我們不應輕蔑地對待別人。

examples.source: She looked at the dirty water with disgust.
examples.target: 她厭惡地看著髒水。

examples.source: The crowd reacted with disgust to the cheating.
examples.target: 人群對作弊行為憤怒地反應。

examples.source: He threw the spoiled food away with disgust.
examples.target: 他厭惡地把變壞的食物扔掉。

with distinction.meaning: 以優異成績 / 以優等成績

examples.source: She passed the exam with distinction.
examples.target: 她以優異成績通過考試。

examples.source: He graduated with distinction.
examples.target: 他以優等成績畢業。

examples.source: The student completed the course with distinction.
examples.target: 學生以優異成績完成課程。

with nothing in return.meaning: 沒有任何回報地 / 不求回報地

examples.source: Volunteers helped with nothing in return.
examples.target: 義工不求回報地幫忙。

examples.source: She gave her time with nothing in return.
examples.target: 她沒有任何回報地付出時間。

examples.source: True kindness can be offered with nothing in return.
examples.target: 真正善意可以是不求回報地付出。

examples.source: The class welcomed the new student with open arms.
examples.target: 全班熱情地歡迎新同學。

examples.source: Her family accepted the idea with open arms.
examples.target: 她的家人欣然接受這個想法。

examples.source: The community welcomed volunteers with open arms.
examples.target: 社區熱情地歡迎義工。

examples.source: Emergency vehicles may move with priority.
examples.target: 緊急車輛可以有優先通行權地行駛。

examples.source: Buses pass through this lane with priority.
examples.target: 巴士可有優先通行權地通過這條行車線。

examples.source: The system handles urgent cases with priority.
examples.target: 系統會優先處理緊急個案。

examples.source: The playground was designed with safety in mind.
examples.target: 遊樂場設計時以安全為考慮。

examples.source: Plan the trip with safety in mind.
examples.target: 計劃旅程時要以安全為考慮。

examples.source: The experiment was done with safety in mind.
examples.target: 實驗以安全為考慮進行。

examples.source: He walked with the aid of a stick.
examples.target: 他借助手杖行走。

examples.source: Students learned pronunciation with the aid of audio.
examples.target: 學生借助音訊學習發音。

examples.source: The map was made with the aid of satellite images.
examples.target: 地圖是在衛星圖片幫助下製作的。

examples.source: Everyone arrived on time, with the exception of Tom.
examples.target: 除了 Tom 之外，所有人都準時到達。

examples.source: The shop opens daily, with the exception of Sundays.
examples.target: 除了星期日之外，店舖每日營業。

examples.source: All answers were correct, with the exception of one.
examples.target: 除了其中一題之外，所有答案都正確。

examples.source: The file was changed without my knowledge.
examples.target: 檔案在我不知情下被更改。

examples.source: Do not share photos without someone's knowledge.
examples.target: 不要在別人不知情下分享相片。

examples.source: The meeting was arranged without her knowledge.
examples.target: 會議在她不知情下被安排。

examples.source: He copied the sentence word for word.
examples.target: 他逐字逐句地抄下句子。

examples.source: Do not translate every line word for word.
examples.target: 不要逐字逐句地翻譯每一行。

examples.source: She remembered the speech word for word.
examples.target: 她逐字逐句地記住了演說。

examples.source: The short deadline worked against us.
examples.target: 很短的限期對我們不利。

examples.source: His lack of experience worked against him.
examples.target: 缺乏經驗對他不利。

examples.source: Bad weather worked against the team.
examples.target: 惡劣天氣對團隊不利。

work at one's own pace.meaning: 按自己的節奏學習 / 工作

examples.source: Students can work at their own pace in the app.
examples.target: 學生可以在 app 按自己的節奏學習。

examples.source: She likes to work at her own pace.
examples.target: 她喜歡按自己的節奏工作。

examples.source: The course lets children work at their own pace.
examples.target: 課程讓孩子按自己的節奏學習。

work in progress.meaning: 未完成作品 / 進行中的作品

examples.source: My essay is still a work in progress.
examples.target: 我的作文仍是未完成作品。

examples.source: The game is a work in progress.
examples.target: 這個遊戲仍是進行中的作品。

examples.source: The painting looked like a beautiful work in progress.
examples.target: 這幅畫看起來像美麗的未完成作品。

work one's way out.meaning: 設法脫身 / 找路出去

examples.source: They worked their way out of the maze.
examples.target: 他們設法走出迷宮。

examples.source: She worked her way out of the difficult situation.
examples.target: 她設法擺脫困難處境。

examples.source: He stayed calm and worked his way out.
examples.target: 他保持冷靜並設法脫身。

work out a schedule.meaning: 制定時間表 / 安排更表

examples.source: We need to work out a schedule for revision.
examples.target: 我們需要制定溫習時間表。

examples.source: The manager worked out a schedule for the staff.
examples.target: 經理為員工安排更表。

examples.source: Can you work out a schedule before Monday?
examples.target: 你可以在星期一前制定時間表嗎？

work out details.meaning: 商定細節 / 解決細節問題

examples.source: The two schools worked out the details of the trip.
examples.target: 兩間學校商定了旅程細節。

examples.source: We still need to work out details before the event.
examples.target: 活動前我們仍要解決細節問題。

examples.source: The team met to work out the final details.
examples.target: 團隊開會商定最後細節。

work out the bugs.meaning: 修正問題 / 解決故障

examples.source: The developer worked out the bugs before launch.
examples.target: 開發者在推出前修正問題。

examples.source: We tested the app to work out the bugs.
examples.target: 我們測試 app 來解決故障。

examples.source: It took a week to work out the bugs in the system.
examples.target: 花了一星期才修正系統問題。

examples.source: We need to work out whether the answer is correct.
examples.target: 我們需要弄清楚答案是否正確。

examples.source: She tried to work out whether he was joking.
examples.target: 她嘗試弄清楚他是否在開玩笑。

examples.source: The teacher worked out whether the class understood.
examples.target: 老師弄清楚全班是否明白。

work up to.meaning: 逐步做到 / 慢慢進展到

examples.source: Start with five minutes and work up to twenty.
examples.target: 由五分鐘開始，逐步做到二十分鐘。

examples.source: She worked up to reading a full chapter.
examples.target: 她慢慢進展到能讀完整一章。

examples.source: The runner worked up to longer distances.
examples.target: 跑手逐步做到更長距離。

examples.source: The work-from-home trend changed office life.
examples.target: 在家工作趨勢改變了辦公室生活。

examples.source: Many parents joined the work-from-home trend.
examples.target: 很多家長加入了在家工作趨勢。

examples.source: The work-from-home trend made online meetings common.
examples.target: 在家工作趨勢令網上會議變得常見。

worked up.meaning: 激動的 / 緊張不安的

examples.source: Do not get worked up over one mistake.
examples.target: 不要因一個錯誤而激動。

examples.source: She felt worked up before the interview.
examples.target: 面試前她感到緊張不安。

examples.source: He was too worked up to speak calmly.
examples.target: 他太激動，無法冷靜說話。

worth checking out.meaning: 值得看看 / 值得了解的

examples.source: This book is worth checking out.
examples.target: 這本書值得看看。

examples.source: The new museum is worth checking out.
examples.target: 新博物館值得了解一下。

examples.source: Her website is worth checking out for study tips.
examples.target: 她的網站有學習貼士，值得看看。

examples.source: It wouldn't hurt to ask for help.
examples.target: 不妨尋求幫助。

examples.source: It wouldn't hurt to check your answer again.
examples.target: 再檢查答案也無妨。

examples.source: It wouldn't hurt to arrive ten minutes early.
examples.target: 早十分鐘到也無妨。

examples.source: I cannot wrap my head around this grammar rule yet.
examples.target: 我還未能理解這條文法規則。

examples.source: She needed time to wrap her head around the news.
examples.target: 她需要時間想明白這個消息。

examples.source: The idea is hard to wrap your head around at first.
examples.target: 這個想法一開始很難理解。

wrapped up.meaning: 裹得暖暖的 / 包裹著的

examples.source: The baby was wrapped up in a blanket.
examples.target: 嬰兒裹在毛氈裏。

examples.source: Everyone was wrapped up against the cold.
examples.target: 大家都裹得暖暖的防寒。

examples.source: The gift was wrapped up in blue paper.
examples.target: 禮物用藍色紙包裹著。

examples.source: One dishonest act can wreck your reputation.
examples.target: 一次不誠實行為可以破壞你的名聲。

examples.source: False rumours may wreck a person's reputation.
examples.target: 不實謠言可能破壞一個人的名聲。

examples.source: The scandal wrecked the company's reputation.
examples.target: 醜聞破壞了公司的名聲。

wrinkle one's nose.meaning: 皺起鼻子 / 表示厭惡

examples.source: She wrinkled her nose at the bad smell.
examples.target: 她聞到臭味時皺起鼻子。

examples.source: The child wrinkled his nose at the bitter medicine.
examples.target: 小孩對苦藥皺起鼻子。

examples.source: He wrinkled his nose to show disgust.
examples.target: 他皺起鼻子表示厭惡。

examples.source: The website has a short write-up about the museum.
examples.target: 網站有一篇關於博物館的簡介。

examples.source: Please prepare a write-up for your project.
examples.target: 請為你的 project 準備文字介紹。

examples.source: Her write-up made the event sound exciting.
examples.target: 她的文字介紹令活動聽起來很精彩。

wade through.meaning: 費力讀完 / 艱難處理

examples.source: I had to wade through a long report.
examples.target: 我不得不費力讀完一份長報告。

examples.source: She waded through hundreds of emails after the holiday.
examples.target: 假期後，她艱難處理數百封電郵。

examples.source: Students waded through the difficult article together.
examples.target: 學生一起費力讀完那篇困難文章。

wake up to.meaning: 開始意識到 / 醒覺到

examples.source: People are waking up to the danger of online scams.
examples.target: 人們開始意識到網上騙案的危險。

examples.source: The city woke up to the need for cleaner transport.
examples.target: 城市醒覺到需要更清潔的交通。

examples.source: He finally woke up to the importance of sleep.
examples.target: 他終於開始意識到睡眠的重要。

examples.source: The final report watered down the criticism.
examples.target: 最終報告淡化了批評。

examples.source: Do not water down your main point too much.
examples.target: 不要過分削弱你的重點。

examples.source: The rule was watered down after complaints.
examples.target: 規則在投訴後被削弱了。

watered-down.meaning: 淡化了的 / 弱化了的

examples.source: The watered-down plan pleased nobody.
examples.target: 淡化了的計劃沒有人滿意。

examples.source: He gave a watered-down version of the story.
examples.target: 他講了一個弱化了的故事版本。

examples.source: The speech felt watered-down and unclear.
examples.target: 演說感覺被淡化了，而且不清楚。

examples.source: He tried to wean himself from late-night gaming.
examples.target: 他嘗試戒掉深夜打機。

examples.source: She weaned herself from checking her phone every minute.
examples.target: 她逐漸擺脫每分鐘查看手機的習慣。

examples.source: Students can wean themselves from translation apps slowly.
examples.target: 學生可以慢慢戒掉依賴翻譯應用程式。

wear one's heart on one's sleeve.meaning: 感情外露 / 把情緒表露出來

examples.source: She wears her heart on her sleeve.
examples.target: 她感情很外露。

examples.source: He wears his heart on his sleeve when watching films.
examples.target: 他看電影時很容易把情緒表露出來。

examples.source: It is brave to wear your heart on your sleeve sometimes.
examples.target: 有時把情緒表露出來也是勇敢的。

examples.source: The writer weaves humour into a serious story.
examples.target: 作者把幽默融入嚴肅故事。

examples.source: Teachers can weave games into grammar lessons.
examples.target: 老師可以把遊戲融入文法課。

examples.source: She wove family memories into her speech.
examples.target: 她把家庭回憶編入演說中。

examples.source: It rained for weeks on end.
examples.target: 雨連續下了幾個星期。

examples.source: She practised piano for weeks on end before the exam.
examples.target: 考試前，她連續幾個星期練琴。

examples.source: The website was updated for weeks on end.
examples.target: 網站連續幾個星期都有更新。

weigh heavily on.meaning: 沉重地壓在...心上 / 使...憂慮

examples.source: The exam results weighed heavily on his mind.
examples.target: 考試成績沉重地壓在他心上。

examples.source: Family problems can weigh heavily on students.
examples.target: 家庭問題可以使學生很憂慮。

examples.source: The decision weighed heavily on the principal.
examples.target: 這個決定令校長感到沉重。

weigh one's options.meaning: 權衡選擇 / 考慮各種選項

examples.source: She weighed her options before choosing a course.
examples.target: 她選課前權衡了各種選擇。

examples.source: We need time to weigh our options.
examples.target: 我們需要時間考慮各種選項。

examples.source: He weighed his options and decided to stay.
examples.target: 他權衡選擇後決定留下。

weight lifted off.meaning: 壓力被釋放 / 如釋重負

examples.source: After the test, it felt like a weight lifted off.
examples.target: 測驗後，我感到如釋重負。

examples.source: Her apology was a weight lifted off my mind.
examples.target: 她的道歉令我心中壓力被釋放。

examples.source: When the problem was solved, a weight lifted off the team.
examples.target: 問題解決後，團隊如釋重負。

weight on one's shoulders.meaning: 沉重負擔 / 壓在肩上的重擔

examples.source: The captain had a weight on his shoulders.
examples.target: 隊長肩上有沉重負擔。

examples.source: She felt the weight on her shoulders before the performance.
examples.target: 表演前，她感到肩上的重擔。

examples.source: Do not carry every problem as a weight on your shoulders.
examples.target: 不要把每個問題都當成壓在肩上的重擔。

examples.source: She is well versed in local history.
examples.target: 她熟悉本地歷史。

examples.source: The teacher is well versed in exam skills.
examples.target: 老師精通考試技巧。

examples.source: He is well versed in using digital tools.
examples.target: 他熟悉使用數碼工具。

examples.source: She grew up in a well-to-do family.
examples.target: 她在富裕家庭長大。

examples.source: The area is popular with well-to-do residents.
examples.target: 這個地區受富裕居民歡迎。

examples.source: A well-to-do customer bought the painting.
examples.target: 一位富裕的顧客買了那幅畫。

examples.source: Were it not for your help, I would be lost.
examples.target: 若不是因為你的幫忙，我會不知所措。

examples.source: Were it not for the rain, we would play outside.
examples.target: 若不是因為下雨，我們會在外面玩。

examples.source: Were it not for her advice, he might give up.
examples.target: 若不是因為她的建議，他可能會放棄。

what makes someone tick.meaning: 某人的動機 / 某人的想法

examples.source: The interview reveals what makes the athlete tick.
examples.target: 訪問揭示了那位運動員的動機。

examples.source: Good teachers try to understand what makes students tick.
examples.target: 好老師會嘗試了解學生的想法。

examples.source: The story shows what makes the main character tick.
examples.target: 故事展示了主角的內在動機。

what to make of.meaning: 該怎樣理解 / 對...有何看法

examples.source: I do not know what to make of his answer.
examples.target: 我不知道該怎樣理解他的答案。

examples.source: What do you make of the new rule?
examples.target: 你對新規則有何看法？

examples.source: The teacher asked what we made of the ending.
examples.target: 老師問我們對結局有何看法。

examples.source: When in Rome, do as the Romans do and follow local manners.
examples.target: 入鄉隨俗，遵守當地禮儀。

examples.source: She tried the local breakfast because when in Rome, do as the Romans do.
examples.target: 她試了當地早餐，因為要入鄉隨俗。

examples.source: The guide reminded us: when in Rome, do as the Romans do.
examples.target: 導遊提醒我們：入鄉隨俗。

where someone is coming from.meaning: 某人的想法來源 / 某人為何這樣想

examples.source: I understand where you are coming from.
examples.target: 我明白你為何這樣想。

examples.source: The teacher listened to where the student was coming from.
examples.target: 老師聆聽學生想法的來源。

examples.source: Before you disagree, ask where she is coming from.
examples.target: 反對前，先問清楚她為何這樣想。

examples.source: We whiled away the afternoon in the library.
examples.target: 我們在圖書館悠閒地消磨了下午。

examples.source: He whiled away the wait by reading comics.
examples.target: 他看漫畫來消磨等候時間。

examples.source: They whiled away a rainy day with board games.
examples.target: 他們用桌上遊戲消磨下雨天。

examples.source: She listened to music to while away the time.
examples.target: 她聽音樂來消磨時間。

examples.source: We played word games to while away the time.
examples.target: 我們玩文字遊戲來消磨時間。

examples.source: He whiled away the time at the airport.
examples.target: 他在機場消磨時間。

examples.source: She whipped out her phone to take a photo.
examples.target: 她迅速拿出手機拍照。

examples.source: The student whipped out a notebook.
examples.target: 學生迅速拿出筆記簿。

examples.source: He whipped out his card and paid for lunch.
examples.target: 他迅速拿出卡付款買午餐。

examples.source: Children whizzed around the playground.
examples.target: 孩子們在操場快速四處穿梭。

examples.source: Delivery bikes whizz around the busy streets.
examples.target: 外賣單車在繁忙街道快速穿梭。

examples.source: Ideas whizzed around her mind before the speech.
examples.target: 演講前，各種想法在她腦海快速閃過。

whole new lease on life.meaning: 煥然一新的生活感 / 新的人生動力

examples.source: The hobby gave him a whole new lease on life.
examples.target: 這個興趣給了他新的人生動力。

examples.source: After moving schools, she felt a whole new lease on life.
examples.target: 轉校後，她有煥然一新的生活感。

examples.source: The new park gave the district a whole new lease on life.
examples.target: 新公園令這個地區煥然一新。

will someone on.meaning: 為某人打氣 / 盼望某人成功

examples.source: The crowd willed the runner on.
examples.target: 觀眾為那名跑手打氣。

examples.source: We willed her on during the final question.
examples.target: 最後一題時，我們為她打氣。

examples.source: His friends willed him on to finish the race.
examples.target: 朋友們盼望他成功完成比賽。

examples.source: The survey measured customers' willingness to pay.
examples.target: 問卷量度顧客的付費意願。

examples.source: High quality can increase willingness to pay.
examples.target: 高質素可以提高付費意願。

examples.source: Students discussed their willingness to pay for online courses.
examples.target: 學生討論他們對網上課程的付費意願。

win someone over to.meaning: 說服某人支持 / 使某人接受

examples.source: She won her parents over to the plan.
examples.target: 她說服父母支持這個計劃。

examples.source: The speech won many students over to the idea.
examples.target: 演說使很多學生接受這個想法。

examples.source: Clear evidence can win people over to change.
examples.target: 清楚證據可以說服人們接受改變。

window into.meaning: 了解...的窗口 / 洞察...的方法

examples.source: The diary is a window into her childhood.
examples.target: 日記是了解她童年的窗口。

examples.source: This poem gives us a window into the writer's mind.
examples.target: 這首詩讓我們洞察作者的內心。

examples.source: Old photos are a window into the past.
examples.target: 舊相片是了解過去的窗口。

examples.source: The internship was a window to her future ambitions.
examples.target: 實習是通往她未來抱負的窗口。

examples.source: The competition became a window to his future ambitions.
examples.target: 比賽成為通往他未來抱負的窗口。

examples.source: A school project can be a window to students' future ambitions.
examples.target: 學校專題可以是通往學生未來抱負的窗口。

wired for.meaning: 天生適合 / 天生具備...能力的

examples.source: Some people are wired for creative work.
examples.target: 有些人天生適合創意工作。

examples.source: She seems wired for leadership.
examples.target: 她似乎天生具備領導能力。

examples.source: Not everyone is wired for noisy classrooms.
examples.target: 不是每個人都天生適合嘈雜課室。

with a heavy heart.meaning: 懷著沉重心情 / 不情願地

examples.source: With a heavy heart, she said goodbye.
examples.target: 她懷著沉重心情道別。

examples.source: He accepted the result with a heavy heart.
examples.target: 他懷著沉重心情接受結果。

examples.source: With a heavy heart, the team cancelled the event.
examples.target: 團隊不情願地取消活動。

with all due respect.meaning: 恕我直言 / 恕我冒昧

examples.source: With all due respect, I disagree with that idea.
examples.target: 恕我直言，我不同意那個想法。

examples.source: With all due respect, the plan needs more detail.
examples.target: 恕我冒昧，這個計劃需要更多細節。

examples.source: With all due respect, this answer is not clear enough.
examples.target: 恕我直言，這個答案不夠清楚。

with finesse.meaning: 技巧純熟地 / 細膩地

examples.source: She handled the difficult question with finesse.
examples.target: 她技巧純熟地處理了難題。

examples.source: The chef decorated the cake with finesse.
examples.target: 廚師細膩地裝飾蛋糕。

examples.source: He solved the conflict with finesse.
examples.target: 他技巧純熟地解決衝突。

with it.meaning: 貼近潮流的 / 時髦的

examples.source: My aunt is surprisingly with it.
examples.target: 我姨姨出奇地貼近潮流。

examples.source: The shop wants to look young and with it.
examples.target: 這間店想顯得年輕時髦。

examples.source: He uses new slang to sound with it.
examples.target: 他使用新潮語，想聽起來貼近潮流。

with justification.meaning: 有充分理由地 / 理據充分地

examples.source: The teacher was angry with justification.
examples.target: 老師生氣是有充分理由的。

examples.source: They complained with justification about the delay.
examples.target: 他們對延誤作出投訴，理據充分。

examples.source: The rule was changed with justification.
examples.target: 規則有充分理由地被修改。

examples.source: Young artists are often asked to work for exposure.
examples.target: 年輕藝術家常被要求為曝光率而免費工作。

examples.source: She refused to work for exposure again.
examples.target: 她拒絕再為曝光率而免費工作。

examples.source: The article questions whether students should work for exposure.
examples.target: 文章質疑學生是否應為曝光率而免費工作。

work in a bubble.meaning: 閉門造車 / 與外界隔絕地工作

examples.source: The team worked in a bubble and missed users' needs.
examples.target: 團隊閉門造車，忽略了用家需要。

examples.source: Writers should not work in a bubble all the time.
examples.target: 作家不應一直與外界隔絕地工作。

examples.source: Feedback helps students avoid working in a bubble.
examples.target: 回饋幫助學生避免閉門造車。

work its way up.meaning: 逐步向上傳遞 / 慢慢進入

examples.source: The news worked its way up to the principal.
examples.target: 消息逐步傳到校長那裏。

examples.source: The smell worked its way up the stairs.
examples.target: 氣味慢慢沿樓梯傳上來。

examples.source: The idea worked its way up through the company.
examples.target: 這個想法逐步在公司向上傳遞。

work one's way around.meaning: 邊工作邊周遊 / 靠工作一路走遍

examples.source: He worked his way around Europe in summer.
examples.target: 他夏天靠工作一路周遊歐洲。

examples.source: She worked her way around different cafés to learn baking.
examples.target: 她在不同咖啡店邊工作邊學烘焙。

examples.source: The traveller worked his way around several cities.
examples.target: 那名旅客靠工作走遍幾個城市。

work out the kinks.meaning: 解決小問題 / 調整細節

examples.source: We need a week to work out the kinks in the app.
examples.target: 我們需要一星期解決應用程式的小問題。

examples.source: The team worked out the kinks before launch.
examples.target: 團隊在推出前調整好細節。

examples.source: Practice helps work out the kinks in a presentation.
examples.target: 練習有助解決演示的小問題。

worm through.meaning: 艱難地穿過 / 慢慢擠過

examples.source: We wormed through the crowded market.
examples.target: 我們艱難地穿過擠迫的市場。

examples.source: The cat wormed through a small gap.
examples.target: 貓慢慢擠過一個小縫。

examples.source: Students wormed through the narrow doorway.
examples.target: 學生艱難地穿過狹窄門口。

worth one's salt.meaning: 稱職的 / 名副其實的

examples.source: Any teacher worth her salt prepares carefully.
examples.target: 任何稱職的老師都會細心備課。

examples.source: A guide worth his salt knows the local history.
examples.target: 名副其實的導遊熟悉本地歷史。

examples.source: Any app worth its salt should work offline.
examples.target: 任何稱職的應用程式都應能離線使用。

worth the paper it is printed on.meaning: 有實際價值的 / 值得相信的

examples.source: A promise is not worth the paper it is printed on if nobody keeps it.
examples.target: 如果沒有人遵守，承諾就沒有實際價值。

examples.source: The contract is worth the paper it is printed on only if it is enforced.
examples.target: 合約只有在被執行時才有實際價值。

examples.source: Without evidence, the certificate is barely worth the paper it is printed on.
examples.target: 沒有證據，證書幾乎不值得相信。

wrangle up.meaning: 費力找來 / 設法弄到

examples.source: She wrangled up enough chairs for the guests.
examples.target: 她費力找來足夠椅子給客人。

examples.source: The teacher wrangled up volunteers for the activity.
examples.target: 老師設法找來活動義工。

examples.source: We wrangled up some old tablets for the lesson.
examples.target: 我們費力找來幾部舊平板電腦上課。

examples.source: The new protection was written into law last year.
examples.target: 新的保障去年被寫入法律。

examples.source: Some rights are written into law.
examples.target: 有些權利是寫入法律的。

examples.source: The rule became stronger after it was written into law.
examples.target: 規則寫入法律後變得更有力。
